rationale: C16 is an exceptionally close template: it uses the same 1947–1961 period, Eighty-seventh Congress, Government Operations committee, study purpose, Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, presidential-approval wording, and effective-on-filing clause. The child principally changes the Senate committee to its House counterpart and adds excess-profits returns. C12 and C07 also closely match the House committee and substantive purpose, but require more updating of dates and congressional references.
